					PE = mgh				(6.5) 
SI Unit of Gravitational Potential Energy: joule (J)

3. Set the final total mechanical energy of the object (Ef) equal to the initial total mechanical energy (E0), as in Equations 6.9a and 6.9b. The total mechanical energy is the sum of the kinetic and potential energies.
